entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. I need to return something, and I need to do it NOW.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. I can certainly help you today. May I have your name and order number to start?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number 77-8-1-9-5-2. I bought this helmet and it's just been sitting here. This is ridiculous, I want a refund immediately.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloFit Aero-Sprint helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with it?

What's the issue? The issue is I don't want it! The color is completely different than what I saw online, and it's been sitting in my closet ever since. The box is still unopened! This should be a simple refund, and if I don't get it, you'll be hearing from my credit card company and seeing my reviews everywhere.
I understand your frustration with the color not meeting your expectations. Just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the helmet or a preference issue?

Are you listening? I just said the box is unopened! How would I know if there's a fault? This is about your company's policy. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager right now?

That won't be necessary, Mark, I can definitely handle this for you. Your safety is our top priority, so we have clear guidelines for returns on equipment like a helmet. I just need to verify your purchase date against our policy. Please hold for one moment.
Thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that your order was delivered 81 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
And? Don't leave me hanging. What does that mean? Are you going to deny it?

Not at all. It means you are well within the valid return period. I am approving your return for a full refund right now. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. As soon as we receive the helmet, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. So... it's approved? You're not going to fight me on it?
That's correct, it's approved. Since the box is unopened and you're within the 90-day window, it's a very straightforward process. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No... that's it. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
